title: Accept the issuer URL as a valid audience

target.summary: When get_audiences() returns an empty list (the default implementation in JWTBearerGrant), verify_claims only issues a deprecation warning instead of rejecting the token. This skips audience value validation and allows assertions intended for other recipients to be accepted, violating RFC 7523 Section 3.
notes: faulty statement: verify_claims only emits a deprecation warning instead of rejecting the token when audiences is empty
definition of the method whose behavior is wrong
